title: Headless build in Brett's axHub repo (this clone, branch claude/approve-now).
asked: Headless build in Brett's axHub repo (this clone, branch claude/approve-now). Read CLAUDE.md and the repo rules first. Opus, one session. Brett: "There's no approve button next to the deny button. I want it so I can stop the timer." Veto calls (policy veto) are held on a 90 s countdown and run by themselves unless denied. Add **Approve now** = run it immediately and end the countdown, everywhere Deny appears: 1. The approval page (/auth/admin/approvals/<id>): a green Approve now button next to the red Deny, same size, big tap targets on a phone, live countdown shown; after tapping, the page shows Running then the result. 2. The approvals list/banner in the axHub web app: Approve now + Deny on every row, including collapsed rows; the title truncates first, never the buttons. 3. Push notifications (ntfy and any other notifier): add an Approve now action button next to Deny. 4. API: POST /auth/api/approvals/<id>/approve (or reuse the existing approve route) works for veto holds: runs the held call now, idempotent, admin-only, audited like deny. A veto that already ran or was denied returns a clear message. Tests for the route + the hold state machine (approve before timer -> runs once; timer firing after approve -> no second run). Run the full test suite. Commit, push the branch, open a PR, then merge into main and push main when green (Brett wants it live tonight), and redeploy axHub the way the repo's deploy docs say. Report in detailed style to the PR body.

result.summary: Approve = Approve now on veto calls (/approve alias + generic approve), idempotent, clear 409s; ntfy Deny/Approve now/Shelve buttons; decision #105; 461 tests green; merged to main (c9d1afe). Not done: PR (no GitHub API auth in session), Coolify redeploy (no API token; live hub still afffc6e).
